And honestly? You don't need to wait until January to start. Save this workout and do it 4× a week using light weights. I am using 2kg each dumbbell 👌  You don't need hours in the gym. You need consistency. And if you combine your workouts with simple nutrition habits, you can make even more progress by Christmas. 🥩 Include protein at every meal — eggs, Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, chicken, fish, lean meat, beans or tofu. 🥦 Fill half your plate with vegetables whenever you can. 🍓 Choose whole foods most of the time and keep highly processed snacks as occasional foods rather than everyday staples. 💧 Drink enough water — thirst can sometimes feel like hunger. Aim for 4 workouts a week + better food choices + consistency. 1. Eating too little — Your body needs enough food and energy to function properly. 2. Expecting overnight results — Healthy progress takes time, so be patient with yourself. 3. Ignoring your daily steps — Using a walking app can help you track your steps, stay motivated and work towards your daily movement goals! (I use Fastwalk) 4. Not drinking enough water — Keep a water bottle nearby and drink regularly throughout the day. 5. Doing workouts you hate — Find activities you genuinely enjoy so it’s easier to stay consistent. 6. Comparing your progress to others — Everyone’s body and journey are different, so focus on yourself. 7. Being too hard on yourself — Remember, consistency matters more than perfection. Give yourself grace! 💗 #gymtok #weightlosstips #glowuptips #motivation
